name: jleape-github-io-private
description: Build + encrypt scripts for the stealth apps served from this site.

scripts.encrypt:gambiarra: staticrypt private/_src/apps/gambiarra/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW" --short --remember 30 -d apps/gambiarra --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:gambiarra: npm run install:gambiarra && npm run build:gambiarra && npm run encrypt:gambiarra
scripts.install:aji: npm install --prefix private/_src/apps/aji && npm install --prefix private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace
scripts.build:aji: npm run build --prefix private/_src/apps/aji && npm run build --prefix private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace
scripts.encrypt:aji: staticrypt private/_src/apps/aji/dist/index.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW_AJI" --short --remember 30 -d apps/aji --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock && cp private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace/dist/index.html private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace/dist/marketplace.html && staticrypt private/_src/apps/aji-marketplace/dist/marketplace.html -p "$STATICRYPT_PW_AJI" --short --remember 30 -d apps/aji --template-title Stealth --template-instructions "Enter password to continue." --template-button Unlock
scripts.publish:aji: npm run install:aji && npm run build:aji && npm run encrypt:aji
